tagline: Rust-native simulation engine for photonic chips
description: lightsim is a Rust-native simulation engine for photonic chips. It runs FDTD in 3-D, 2-D or 2.5-D on one GPU, several GPUs or several machines, solves waveguide modes, computes S-parameters and inverse-design gradients, and imports layouts from design tools such as gdsfactory.

films.text: Four silicon-nitride ring squeezers feeding a four-mode interferometer, with the dimensions reported for Xanadu's chip.

key.label: Peak pump power in the bus for r = 1

films.text: A silicon racetrack ring under water: its resonances move with the refractive index of the liquid that covers the chip.
A silicon carrier-depletion modulator: reverse bias on a PN junction in the rib waveguide shifts the phase of the light.

key.label: Modulation efficiency, π shift in 3 mm

films.text: A 4 × 4 µm silicon scatterer whose transmission matrix is the four-point discrete Fourier transform, by inverse design.

install.title: Install
install.intro: lightsim is built from source. A CPU-only build needs Rust and Python and works on Linux and macOS; a GPU build needs an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA 13 and driver 580 or later.

blocks.title: Python package
blocks.code:
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install maturin
maturin develop --release                     # CPU only
maturin develop --release --features cuda     # with GPU support

blocks.title: Command-line program
blocks.code:
cargo build --release -p lightsim-cli                    # CPU only
cargo build --release -p lightsim-cli --features cuda    # with GPU support

quickstart.title: Quick start
quickstart.code:
import gdsfactory as gf, numpy as np
from lightsim.sparams import write_sparameters

gf.gpdk.PDK.activate()
sp = write_sparameters(
    gf.components.mmi1x2(),
    wavelengths=np.linspace(1.5e-6, 1.6e-6, 21),
    device="cuda:0",
)
print(abs(sp["o2@0,o1@0"]) ** 2)   # 0.49 at 1.55 um
quickstart.caption: A gdsfactory component goes in; the port modes are solved on the simulation grid and the S-parameters come back: about 42 s on one RTX PRO 6000 at the default resolution, 28 s with port symmetry.

gamma.name: gamma
gamma.text: An open-source desktop workspace for designing, simulating and testing photonic circuits with lightsim, built for AI agents. Build it from source on macOS or Linux.
